children: The U.K. Debt Management Office sold 3.25 billion pounds ($4.28 billion) in January 2041-dated gilts at an auction on Tuesday, it said.
The following are results of the auction, with amounts in pounds.

Issue              5.25% Jan. 31, 2041 gilt 
Amount on offer    3.25 billion 
Bids received      10.7 billion 
Bids accepted      3.25 billion 
Bid-to-cover ratio 3.28 
Average yield      5.591% 
Average price      96.68 
Maximum yield      5.595% 
Yield Tail         0.5 Bps 
Settlement date    Nov. 18, 2026
